title: Waiting For Tonight
djBio: MisterMiss came up on the Tel Aviv after-hours circuit and still plays like it — long, patient builds that hold a room past the point most sets would break. The edits lean on Levantine vocal lines and old disco records, cut fresh the week they're played.
partyBio: Forever runs the largest queer nights in Tel Aviv, from the beachfront warehouses to the yearly festival week. It started as a one-off birthday party in 2011 and never stopped, and the room is known for booking local residents over touring names.
